lines.trans: Kaiwen and I have followed the boss ever since his days at ME.
He created a string of trendsetting shows there and made his name there too.
Later they went through an agonizing personal upheaval, and the boss chose to resign without a backup plan.

words.gloss: resign without another job lined up
words.gram: Meaning: resign without another job lined up.

lines.trans: Aside from lasting emotional wounds, he took nothing at all away from ME.
He is utterly rational toward work, yet governed by emotion when it comes to people.
Once an emotional choice like that is made, there is no turning back.
He has already decided to leave Xingtian, and we cannot persuade him to come back.
Wait, Mr Chun Yuqiao resigning is huge news, so why has the company issued no internal bulletin?
It makes no difference, since Kaiwen and I have already resigned.
Are the two of you leaving as well?
We came to Xingtian to follow Chun Yuqiao; now that he is gone, why would we stay?

words.gram: Meaning: what are you doing / why.

examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.

examples.text: 这是都。
examples.trans: This is 都.

examples.text: 除了他以外，办公室里其他人都下班了。
examples.trans: Apart from him, everyone else in the office has gone home.

examples.text: 这件事除了好朋友，我谁也没告诉。
examples.trans: Besides my close friend, I told nobody about this.

难堪.gloss: painfully embarrassing, awkward, hard to bear

meanings.en: painfully embarrassing, awkward, hard to bear
meanings.note: Emotional distress from public awkwardness or betrayal.

examples.text: 那场突如其来的感情变故曾让年轻时的他陷入极度难堪的境地。
examples.trans: That sudden personal upheaval once left him in painful embarrassment.

examples.text: 体面的沟通能够给彼此留足余地，避免当众难堪。
examples.trans: Graceful communication leaves room for dignity and avoids embarrassment.

examples.text: 最重要的部门还是这边，淳于乔领导的制作部。
examples.trans: Still, the most important department is right here: the production unit led by Chun Yuqiao.

examples.text: 这是领导。 (Example)
examples.trans: This is 领导.

examples.text: 他早年制作的音乐选秀在电视界掀起了一股全新的审美风潮。
examples.trans: His early music talent shows set a fresh creative trend across television.

examples.text: 盲目跟随市场风潮不如沉下心来开创属于自己的新形态。
examples.trans: Better to pioneer fresh formats than blindly chase market trends.
